evidence.ACL: Grade 1 injury or degeneraiton of ACL.
evidence.MCL: The contour of PCL, MCL, and LCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage ( more severe at lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau) and spur formation of right knee, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee, more severe at lateral compartment.
evidence.PF OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of patella, in favor of grade 2-3 chondromalacia.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Bone marrow edema in lateral femoral condyle with R/O small osteonecrosis in subchondral region.
